title: Food & Cafés
tagline: From historic street markets to Michelin dining and afternoon tea.
description: London has transformed into one of the culinary capitals of the world. Sample sizzling artisanal street delicacies at Victorian railway arches, indulge in tiered afternoon tea in Mayfair, experience authentic dumplings in Chinatown, or linger in third-wave specialty coffee shops across Soho.
highlights: Borough Market gourmet treats & cheese tasting
Traditional tiered Afternoon Tea service
Chinatown roast duck & dim sum feasts
Camden Lock waterside international street food
Specialty artisan coffee culture in Soho & Fitzrovia
quote: To eat well in England you should have breakfast three times a day — or better yet, explore London's modern markets.

title: Shopping & Markets
tagline: Centuries-old antique stalls, West End flagships, and hidden mews boutiques.
description: Whether you are treasure hunting for rare 19th-century silver along Portobello Road, exploring high fashion on Regent Street and Bond Street, or browsing craft designers in Covent Garden's Apple Market, London offers retail therapy steeped in character.
highlights: Portobello Road Saturday antique and vintage market
Covent Garden craft stalls & designer flagships
Oxford & Regent Street world-famous department stores
Camden Stables alternative fashion and indie makers
Shoreditch vintage clothing emporiums
quote: From Savile Row tailoring to indie vinyl stalls, shopping in London is an expedition through living history.

title: Culture & Entertainment
tagline: West End theatre magic, world-class free museums, and royal pageantry.
description: Immerse yourself in world-changing culture. Spend your days marvelling at global antiquities in the British Museum and dinosaur skeletons in South Kensington, and spend your evenings catching unforgettable theatre spectacles in Theatreland.
highlights: West End Theatreland world-renowned musicals and plays
Free permanent access to London's supreme national museums
Gothic royal architecture at Westminster and St Paul's
Royal pageantry and Changing of the Guard ceremonies
Cutting-edge contemporary street art across East London
quote: A bad day in London is still better than a good day anywhere else.

title: Scenic London
tagline: Thames riverbank panoramas, royal parklands, and tranquil canal towpaths.
description: London is one of Europe's greenest mega-cities, with nearly 40% public green space and the serpentine River Thames flowing through its heart. Enjoy riverside sunsets on the South Bank, boat cruises down to Greenwich, or quiet canal towpath walks in Little Venice.
highlights: Sunset walks along the South Bank from the Eye to Tower Bridge
Historic clipper boat cruises down the Thames to Greenwich
Quiet canal narrowboat journeys through Little Venice to Camden
Sweeping 360-degree vistas from Parliament Hill and Greenwich Observatory
Royal Park expanses and boating on the Serpentine Lake
quote: When a man is tired of London, he is tired of life; for there is in London all that life can afford.
